notes: Editor preview now renders [word|#hex] / [word] highlight colours instead of showing the literal brackets — in both the main caption preview and text-layer previews. The Highlight reveal animation also previews accurately now: only the highlighted phrase wipes in left-to-right (clip-path on the highlight spans) while the rest of the line stays put, matching the actual render. As a bonus, non-bracket caption text is HTML-escaped in the preview (colours are allow-listed so they can't break the markup). index.html only; a browser hard-refresh picks it up.
